title: MOTION (RAMAN - HUTT) relative to funding for the safety of roadways adjacent to schools.
text:
[Council File 23-0304-S1; CD 4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RAMAN - HUTT) relative to funding for the safety of roadways adjacent to schools.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $76,000 from the Council District 4 portion of the Council Discretionary Street Furniture Fund No. 43D/50 to the Transportation Trust Fund No. 840/94, Account No. 94VE27 (CD 4 Speed Reduction) for speed humps or tables on Densmore Avenue from Ventura Boulevard to Moorpark Street adjacent to Valley Beth Shalom; on Dixie Canyon Avenue from Ventura Boulevard to Moorpark Street adjacent to Dixie Canyon Avenue Elementary School and St. Francis de Sales Church and School; and on Oxnard Street between Lindley Avenue and White Oak Avenue to service the crosswalk at Oxnard Street / Zelzah Avenue which serves Emelita Street Elementary School.
2. AUTHORIZE the Department of Transportation to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
